name: crispe-paper-analyst-plugin
description: Analyze a PDF, arXiv ID/URL or conference paper: full-paper reading, core ideas, key sections, reading priority, industry impact and application feasibility. 中英文论文分析；触发：分析这篇论文、 读一下这个paper、解析论文、值不值得读、能否落地、下一篇 / next paper, analyze/summarize this paper, and bare arXiv IDs/links. 按需协作 / Coordinate scientific-critical-thinking (证据审查), paper-lookup (检索定位), github-deep-research (代码成熟度), literature-review (跨论文综合). 协作前提示缺失技能的原始仓库安装命令 / Show original-repo install commands for missing companions before collaboration. 直接获取目标论文，额外全文先征求同意 / Fetch the target; ask before additional full texts. 窄范围事实查询不触发 / Exclude narrow factual lookups.
